build_LunarMultiheadAttention: build a LunarMultiheadAttention module with configurable heads, projected heads, and optional tied key-value projections
build_LunarCausalAttention: build a LunarCausalAttention module for causal self-attention with linear complexity using projected queries
run_efficient_causal_attention_parallel: run the parallel efficient causal attention operation on batched tensors using cumsum and matmul
run_efficient_causal_attention_seq: run the sequential efficient causal attention operation step by step with an accumulative matrix
run_incremental_causal_attention: run incremental causal attention on single-step tensors with an existing accumulative matrix and step count
